title: A member of Congress saw a UFO come out of a lake while fishing with his son

tellings.quote: I go to Congress and and members of Congress will pull me aside and said look I had my own UFO sighting with my son literally fishing in in in a lake and the thing came out of the water

plain: A member of Congress was fishing on a lake with his son when an object came up out of the water. The former Pentagon intelligence official Luis Elizondo tells Michels that members of Congress pull him aside to share sightings like this one. He gives no name, no lake and no date. He tells it to show that even lawmakers have seen such things themselves.
